result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including a high-visibility continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. However, the environment is characterized by wide lanes that may encourage higher vehicle speeds and a lack of dedicated pedestrian signal heads at the signalized crossing.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: There are no visible dedicated pedestrian signal heads, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle traffic lights which may not provide adequate clearance time.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Exposure
hazards.description: The wide lane widths and lack of a median refuge increase the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic while crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way and clearance information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, uncontrolled pedestrian crossing with high-visibility markings but no signalization or refuge. The multi-lane roadway and lack of traffic calming measures create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: There are no visible traffic signals or stop signs to require vehicles to yield to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of the side path and the main multi-lane road.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated amber LEDs to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts a large, multi-lane intersection with significant crossing distances and high-speed vehicle geometry. While a zebra-marked crosswalk is visible on a side approach, the main thoroughfare lacks visible pedestrian protection or signals, creating a hostile environment for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The main roadway is extremely wide, requiring pedestrians to cover multiple lanes of traffic without a visible refuge island or signalized crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the intersection across the main thoroughfare

hazards.name: High-Speed Turning Geometry
hazards.description: The wide turning radius at the slip lane allows vehicles to maintain high speeds while crossing the marked pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground at the zebra crossing

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised concrete islands in the median to reduce exposure time and allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in stages.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Signals
interventions.description: Mark all legs of the intersection with high-visibility zebra markings and install pedestrian countdown signals to clearly define right-of-way.

result.summary: The intersection features marked crosswalks and curb ramps, but the environment is degraded by faded pavement markings and a lack of continuous sidewalks on all corners. The wide roadway and absence of dedicated pedestrian signals increase exposure risk for people crossing the main thoroughfare.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center across both intersecting streets

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk terminates or is absent on the right side of the side street, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on unpaved grass.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the side street extending into the background

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: Despite being a signalized intersection, there are no visible pedestrian signal heads to indicate safe crossing intervals.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles at the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint all crosswalks using high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the right side of the side street to provide a continuous, separated path for pedestrians.
